preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 3, inclusive.
The number of cities is between 2 and 10^5, and the number of old cities is between 2 and the number of cities.
The number of newer roads is between 0 and 10^5.
The city where Limak lives and the cities connected by newer roads are between 1 and the number of cities.
The length of a road between old cities and the length of newer roads are between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: No two cities are connected with more than one road.
No road connects a city to itself.
It's possible to get from every city to every other city.

postconditions.description: Each line contains N integers, the distance from the city S to the city i.

postconditions.expression: The distance from S to S is 0.
postconditions.description: The first integer in the output is 0.
